words.zh: a. 易受傷害的, 有弱點的, 易受影響的, 脆弱的, 成局的；[醫] 易損的
words.example: Newborns are especially vulnerable to infection because their immune systems are immature.
words.example_zh: 新生兒因免疫系統尚未成熟，特別容易受到感染。

words.zh: n. 屬下, 附屬物；a. 下級的, 次要的, 附屬的；vt. 使居下位, 使服從
words.example: A good leader treats subordinate staff with the same respect as senior colleagues.
words.example_zh: 好的領導者對下屬與資深同事一視同仁地尊重。

words.zh: a. 有害的, 致命的, 惡劣的, 險惡的；[醫] 惡性的
words.example: Smoking has a pernicious effect on nearly every organ in the body.
words.example_zh: 吸菸對身體幾乎每個器官都有有害的影響。

words.zh: n. 釋放, 發洩, 豁免, 發行, 釋放證書；vt. 釋放, 解除, 放鬆, 豁免, 免除, 釋出, 放棄, 讓與；n. 釋出；[計] 版本, 釋出
words.example: The gland releases hormones directly into the bloodstream.
words.example_zh: 腺體將荷爾蒙直接釋放進血液中。

words.zh: n. 精神, 心靈, 靈魂, 態度, 志氣, 人格, 情緒, 心情, 烈酒；vt. 誘拐, 鼓勵, 鼓舞
words.example: The team showed great fighting spirit despite the setback.
words.example_zh: 儘管遭遇挫折，團隊仍展現了高昂的奮鬥精神。

words.zh: a. 內在的, 國內的；[醫] 內的, 內部的
words.example: The company launched an internal investigation into the leak.
words.example_zh: 公司針對洩密展開了內部調查。

words.zh: n. 外部, 外面；a. 外部的, 客觀的, 表面的
words.example: The wound healed, but an external scar remained.
words.example_zh: 傷口癒合了，但外部留下了疤痕。

words.zh: a. 有資格的；給與名稱的
words.example: Full-time employees are entitled to paid annual leave.
words.example_zh: 全職員工有資格享有帶薪年假。

words.zh: n. 制服；a. 統一的, 一律的, 始終如一的
words.example: The samples were kept at a uniform temperature throughout the test.
words.example_zh: 整個實驗過程中，樣本都維持在一致的溫度。

words.zh: a. 樂觀的, 樂觀主義的, 樂天的
words.example: Doctors are optimistic that she will make a full recovery.
words.example_zh: 醫生樂觀地認為她會完全康復。

words.zh: a. 免疫的, 免除的, 不受影響的；n. 免疫者
words.example: Once you have had the disease, you may be immune to it for life.
words.example_zh: 一旦得過這種病，你可能終生對它免疫。

words.zh: n. 改革論者, 進步論者；a. 前進的, 累進的, 進步的
words.example: The disease causes a progressive loss of memory.
words.example_zh: 這種疾病會造成漸進性的記憶喪失。

words.zh: a. 命令的, 託管的；[經] 受託者, 命令者
words.example: Wearing a seatbelt is mandatory for all passengers.
words.example_zh: 所有乘客都必須強制繫安全帶。

words.zh: a. 完全跟據經驗的, 經驗主義的；[醫] 經驗主義的
words.example: Their conclusion is backed by empirical evidence from years of experiments.
words.example_zh: 他們的結論有多年實驗的實證證據支持。

words.zh: n. 原始人, 早期藝術家；a. 原始的, 上古的；[計] 圖元; 原語; 基元
words.example: Primitive tools made of stone have been found at the site.
words.example_zh: 遺址出土了以石頭製成的原始工具。

words.zh: n. 缺乏, 不足；[醫] 缺乏, 不足
words.example: A deficiency of vitamin D can lead to weakened bones.
words.example_zh: 維生素 D 缺乏可能導致骨骼變弱。

words.zh: vt. 使模糊, 弄髒；vi. 弄髒, 模糊
words.example: Tears blurred her vision as she read the letter.
words.example_zh: 讀信時，淚水模糊了她的視線。

words.zh: a. 有利益的, 獲利的, 合算的
words.example: Cosmetic surgery can be a highly lucrative specialty.
words.example_zh: 整形外科可以是利潤很高的專科。

words.zh: vt. 抑制, 阻止, 束縛；[法] 抑制, 遏制, 制止
words.example: She could barely restrain her anger during the meeting.
words.example_zh: 會議中她幾乎無法抑制自己的怒氣。

words.zh: a. 豐富的, 富裕的；n. 支流, 富人
words.example: She grew up in an affluent neighborhood where every house had a pool.
words.example_zh: 她在一個富裕的社區長大，家家戶戶都有泳池。

words.zh: n. 試驗；a. 試驗性的, 暫時的
words.example: We made a tentative plan to meet next week.
words.example_zh: 我們暫定下週見面。

words.zh: vt. 危害, 使受危困, 使陷危地
words.example: One careless mistake could jeopardize the entire mission.
words.example_zh: 一個粗心的錯誤可能危及整個任務。

words.zh: a. 無所不在的, 到處存在的, 普遍存在的
words.example: Smartphones have become ubiquitous in modern life.
words.example_zh: 智慧型手機在現代生活中已無所不在。

words.zh: a. 漠不關心的, 無重要性的, 中立的；[醫] 中性的, 無作用的, 無親和力的, 淡漠的
words.example: She remained indifferent to the criticism and continued her work.
words.example_zh: 她對批評漠不關心，繼續做她的工作。

words.zh: a. 好爭吵的, 愛爭論的, 有異議的；[法] 訴訟的, 爭執的, 引起爭論的
words.example: Funding for the project remains a contentious issue in the committee.
words.example_zh: 該計畫的經費在委員會中仍是個有爭議的議題。

words.zh: n. 不可缺少之物；a. 不可缺少的, 責無旁貸的, 絕對必要的
words.example: Clean water is indispensable to public health.
words.example_zh: 乾淨的水對公共衛生不可或缺。

words.zh: a. 一絲不苟的, 精確的, 過細的
words.example: The surgeon is meticulous about sterilizing every instrument.
words.example_zh: 這位外科醫師對每件器械的消毒都一絲不苟。

words.zh: a. 觸染性的, 會蔓延的；[醫] (接)觸(傳)染的
words.example: Measles is highly contagious and spreads through the air.
words.example_zh: 麻疹傳染性極強，會透過空氣傳播。

words.zh: a. 有責任心的, 負責的, 本著良心的；[法] 憑良心做的, 有道德感的
words.example: A conscientious student reviews her notes the same day she takes them.
words.example_zh: 盡責的學生當天就會複習當天的筆記。

words.zh: vt. 做(惡), 犯(罪), 胡說, 惡劣地做；[法] 犯, 作, 行
words.example: The hackers perpetrated the fraud from another country.
words.example_zh: 駭客從另一個國家犯下這起詐騙。

words.zh: a. 膨脹的, 充了氣的, 誇張的, 通貨膨脹的
words.example: The report gave an inflated estimate of the project's benefits.
words.example_zh: 該報告對計畫效益給出了誇大的估計。

words.zh: n. 無感情, 無興趣, 冷漠；[醫] 無情[感], 淡漠
words.example: Voter apathy led to the lowest turnout in the country's history.
words.example_zh: 選民的冷漠造成該國史上最低的投票率。

words.zh: a. 劇毒的, 致命的, 刻毒的, 惡毒的, 惡性的, 有病毒的, 過強的；[醫] 有毒力的, 毒性的
words.example: A virulent strain of the virus spread rapidly through the ward.
words.example_zh: 一種劇毒的病毒株在病房中迅速傳播。

words.zh: a. 頭腦精明的, 賢明的, 判斷正確的
words.example: A judicious use of resources kept the clinic running through the crisis.
words.example_zh: 明智地運用資源，讓診所撐過了危機。

words.zh: a. 體貼的, 體諒的, 考慮周到的
words.example: It was considerate of you to call before visiting.
words.example_zh: 你來訪前先打電話，真是體貼。

words.zh: a. 第三的, 第三位的, 第三產業的；n. 第三修道會會員, 第三紀；第三的; 三代的(指無機鹽)
words.example: Tertiary education includes universities and colleges.
words.example_zh: 高等教育包含大學與學院。

words.zh: a. 易受騙的；[法] 易受騙的, 輕信的
words.example: He was gullible enough to believe the email promising him a fortune.
words.example_zh: 他輕信到相信那封承諾給他財富的電子郵件。

words.zh: a. 吉兆的, 幸運的
words.example: The clear sky was an auspicious start to their wedding day.
words.example_zh: 晴朗的天空為他們的婚禮揭開了吉祥的序幕。

words.zh: a. 裝飾表面的, 鋪張的, 誇示的, 華美的, 顯眼的
words.example: He drove an ostentatious sports car to impress his clients.
words.example_zh: 他開著一輛炫耀的跑車來打動客戶。

words.zh: 喝醉的,極其興奮的
words.example: He was intoxicated and could not drive home safely.
words.example_zh: 他喝醉了，無法安全開車回家。

words.zh: a. 寬敞的, 方便的
words.example: The hotel suite was commodious enough for the whole family.
words.example_zh: 這間飯店套房寬敞到足以容納全家人。

words.zh: a. 沒有錢的, 身無分文的, 貧窮的
words.example: As an impecunious student, he survived on instant noodles.
words.example_zh: 身為一個身無分文的學生，他靠泡麵度日。

words.zh: a. [法]取消的；v. 撤銷, 取消, 廢除( revoke的過去式和過去分詞 )
words.example: His medical license was revoked after the scandal.
words.example_zh: 醜聞之後，他的醫師執照被撤銷。

words.zh: v. 減輕（alleviate的過去分詞）；使…緩和
words.example: The new medication alleviated her chronic back pain within days.
words.example_zh: 新藥在幾天內就減輕了她的慢性背痛。

words.zh: vt. 積聚, 積累
words.example: Over decades he amassed a vast collection of rare medical texts.
words.example_zh: 數十年間他累積了大量珍稀的醫學典籍。
